name: GiftAider
shortDescription: A UK Gift Aid claim-management and basic charity CRM product, offered as a cloud service or self-hosted system for donor, donation, import, validation and HMRC-submission workflows.
suitableContexts: Church charities that need a dedicated Gift Aid claim workflow
Treasurers importing donations from an existing giving or finance system
Churches that need to choose between cloud-hosted and self-hosted Gift Aid processing

pricing.summary: GiftAider Cloud is advertised from £49.99 per month for the first user, with additional users at £14.99 per month. The self-hosted version is priced on request. The public pricing material does not state full feature boundaries, VAT, onboarding, data migration, HMRC-service, integration, contract or cancellation charges; obtain these in writing.

startingPrice.qualifier: published Cloud price for first user, before VAT if applicable

tiers.label: GiftAider Cloud
tiers.detail: Cloud service for first user; additional users advertised at £14.99 per month.

tiers.label: GiftAider Self-Hosted
tiers.detail: Supplier describes a non-branded version on the church's own server.

gdprInformation: GiftAider publishes a privacy notice identifying Systematic Marketing Ltd as controller for the notice and describing third-party service providers, HMRC reporting, six-year retention for basic customer information and possible international transfers. This does not establish the cloud product's controller-processor allocation or self-hosted responsibilities. Before importing donors, a church should obtain the applicable DPA, hosting and sub-processor list, transfer safeguards, retention, access roles, audit records, incident process and full donor, declaration, claim and attachment export arrangements.
integrations: Supplier describes importing from an existing CRM
Self-hosted edition is described as able to integrate with existing databases and systems
Confirm current connectors, field mapping, API availability and integration costs
importExport: Supplier documents donation-data import and correcting data at source before re-upload
Request full donor, donation, declaration, claim, consent, audit-trail and configuration export specifications
support: Supplier advertises UK office hours Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
Supplier publishes a support centre and migration material from desktop to online
Confirm support response commitments, implementation and migration scope

uk-operator.value: GiftAider's privacy notice identifies Systematic Marketing Ltd as controller, while its site identifies Systematic Marketing Limited as the registered-English operator. Companies House records company 02472380.

hmrc-recognition.value: HMRC's current commercial Charities Online supplier list names Systematic Marketing Ltd and GiftAider or GiftAider Agent.

pricing.value: Supplier advertises GiftAider Cloud from £49.99 per month for the first user and £14.99 per additional user, with self-hosted pricing on request.

workflow.value: Supplier describes donor and donation records, imports, pre-validation and HMRC Gift Aid claim submission.

editorial.assessment: GiftAider is a UK Gift Aid and basic charity CRM system, rather than a full church-management, pastoral-care or safeguarding platform. Its cloud and self-hosted options may be useful where a church has a separate giving system but needs controlled donor, declaration and claim handling. The self-hosted option changes operational responsibility, so it needs a clear technical owner; the cloud option still needs a current data-processing and export review before historical donor data is moved.
bestFor: Church charities seeking a dedicated HMRC Gift Aid workflow
Treasurers needing donation import, validation and claim submission in one product
Churches that can evaluate cloud hosting against their own self-hosted technical capacity
strengths: Active UK operator with current HMRC Charities Online listing
Published cloud entry price and user price
Supplier documents cloud and self-hosted deployment paths
limitations: Not a full church-management, safeguarding or pastoral-record system
Cloud feature boundaries, VAT, contract, migration and integration costs require a written quote
Website privacy notice does not by itself define the product DPA or hosting arrangement
Self-hosting requires church capability for server security, backups, patching and access control

procurementVerdict.problem: Preparing reliable Gift Aid claims from donor and donation records without relying on general spreadsheets
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK dedicated Gift Aid product offering both cloud and self-hosted deployment
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Import a small non-sensitive representative dataset, correct and reconcile one test claim, compare cloud and self-hosted responsibilities and costs, then obtain current DPA, sub-processor, retention, audit and full-export terms before transferring production donor data.
